mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, COALESCE(SUM(status = 'DONE'), 0) AS done_count, COALESCE(SUM(status IN ('CANCELED', 'PARTIAL_CANCELED')), 0) AS canceled_count, COALESCE(SUM( payment.status IN ('ABORTED', 'EXPIRED') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payment_cancellations AS cancellation WHERE cancellation.payment_id = payment.id AND cancellation.status IN ('REQUESTED', 'FAILED') ) ), 0) AS attention_count FROM payments AS payment
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payments ( order_id, toss_order_id, payment_key, idempotency_key, method, amount, status, provider_status, failure_code, failure_message ) SELECT #{orderId}, #{tossOrderId}, #{paymentKey}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{method}, #{amount}, 'READY', #{providerStatus}, #{failureCode}, #{failureMessage} FROM orders AS current_order WHERE current_order.id = #{orderId} AND current_order.status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT' AND current_order.final_amount = #{amount}
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id, toss_order_id, payment_key, idempotency_key, method, amount, status, provider_status, active_payment_order_id, failure_code, failure_message, requested_at, approved_at, canceled_at, created_at, updated_at FROM payments WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY id

SELECT id, order_id, toss_order_id, payment_key, idempotency_key, method, amount, status, provider_status, active_payment_order_id, failure_code, failure_message, requested_at, approved_at, canceled_at, created_at, updated_at FROM payments WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 'READY' LIMIT 1

SELECT id, order_id, toss_order_id, payment_key, idempotency_key, method, amount, status, provider_status, active_payment_order_id, failure_code, failure_message, requested_at, approved_at, canceled_at, created_at, updated_at FROM payments WHERE id = #{paymentId}

SELECT id, order_id, toss_order_id, payment_key, idempotency_key, method, amount, status, provider_status, active_payment_order_id, failure_code, failure_message, requested_at, approved_at, canceled_at, created_at, updated_at FROM payments WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 'DONE' LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE payments AS payment INNER JOIN orders AS current_order ON current_order.id = payment.order_id SET payment.status = 'DONE', payment.payment_key = #{paymentKey}, payment.method = #{method}, payment.provider_status = #{providerStatus}, payment.approved_at = #{approvedAt}, payment.failure_code = NULL, payment.failure_message = NULL WHERE payment.id = #{paymentId} AND payment.status = 'READY' AND current_order.status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT'
UPDATE payments SET status = 'ABORTED', provider_status = #{providerStatus}, failure_code = #{failureCode}, failure_message = #{failureMessage} WHERE id = #{paymentId} AND status = 'READY'
UPDATE payments SET status = 'EXPIRED', provider_status = #{providerStatus}, failure_code = #{failureCode}, failure_message = #{failureMessage} WHERE id = #{paymentId} AND status = 'READY'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_cancellations ( payment_id, idempotency_key, cancel_amount, cancel_reason, request_type, requested_by, status ) SELECT payment.id, #{idempotencyKey}, #{cancelAmount}, #{cancelReason}, #{requestType}, #{requestedBy}, 'REQUESTED' FROM payments AS payment WHERE payment.id = #{paymentId} AND payment.status = 'DONE' AND #{cancelAmount} = payment.amount
mapper.select: SELECT id, payment_id, idempotency_key, cancel_amount, cancel_reason, request_type, requested_by, status, active_requested_payment_id, transaction_key, failure_code, failure_message, requested_at, canceled_at, created_at, updated_at FROM payment_cancellations WHERE id = #{cancellationId}

SELECT id, payment_id, idempotency_key, cancel_amount, cancel_reason, request_type, requested_by, status, active_requested_payment_id, transaction_key, failure_code, failure_message, requested_at, canceled_at, created_at, updated_at FROM payment_cancellations WHERE idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}

SELECT id, payment_id, idempotency_key, cancel_amount, cancel_reason, request_type, requested_by, status, active_requested_payment_id, transaction_key, failure_code, failure_message, requested_at, canceled_at, created_at, updated_at FROM payment_cancellations WHERE active_requested_payment_id = #{paymentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_cancellations ( payment_id, idempotency_key, cancel_amount, cancel_reason, request_type, requested_by, status ) SELECT payment.id, #{idempotencyKey}, payment.amount, #{cancelReason}, 'SYSTEM_COMPENSATION', NULL, 'REQUESTED' FROM payments AS payment WHERE payment.id = #{paymentId} AND payment.status IN ('READY', 'DONE') AND payment.amount = #{cancelAmount} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE payment_cancellations.id = LAST_INSERT_ID(payment_cancellations.id)
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_cancellations SET status = 'REQUESTED', failure_code = NULL, failure_message = NULL, transaction_key = NULL, canceled_at = NULL WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} AND request_type = 'SYSTEM_COMPENSATION' AND status = 'FAILED' AND failure_code = 'PAYMENT_NOT_APPROVED'
mapper.select: SELECT id, payment_id, idempotency_key, cancel_amount, cancel_reason, request_type, requested_by, status, active_requested_payment_id, transaction_key, failure_code, failure_message, requested_at, canceled_at, created_at, updated_at FROM payment_cancellations WHERE status = 'REQUESTED' AND request_type = 'SYSTEM_COMPENSATION' ORDER BY requested_at, id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_cancellations AS cancellation INNER JOIN payments AS payment ON payment.id = cancellation.payment_id SET cancellation.status = 'DONE', cancellation.transaction_key = #{transactionKey}, cancellation.canceled_at = #{canceledAt}, cancellation.failure_code = NULL, cancellation.failure_message = NULL, payment.status = 'CANCELED', payment.provider_status = 'CANCELED', payment.canceled_at = #{canceledAt}, payment.failure_code = NULL, payment.failure_message = NULL WHERE cancellation.id = #{cancellationId} AND cancellation.status = 'REQUESTED' AND payment.status = 'DONE'

UPDATE payment_cancellations AS cancellation INNER JOIN payments AS payment ON payment.id = cancellation.payment_id SET cancellation.status = 'DONE', cancellation.transaction_key = #{transactionKey}, cancellation.canceled_at = #{canceledAt}, cancellation.failure_code = NULL, cancellation.failure_message = NULL, payment.status = 'CANCELED', payment.payment_key = COALESCE(payment.payment_key, #{paymentKey}), payment.provider_status = 'CANCELED', payment.canceled_at = #{canceledAt}, payment.failure_code = 'INTERNAL_COMPLETION_FAILED', payment.failure_message = '내부 주문 처리 실패로 승인 결제를 자동 취소했습니다.' WHERE cancellation.id = #{cancellationId} AND cancellation.status = 'REQUESTED' AND cancellation.request_type = 'SYSTEM_COMPENSATION' AND payment.status IN ('READY', 'DONE') AND (payment.payment_key IS NULL OR payment.payment_key = #{paymentKey})
